subject: radish-jellyfish character
art_direction: 一颗倒挂萝卜像轻盈水母，叶片卷成顶冠，短根须像裙摆，奶粉与墨绿构图清爽。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Fuse a radish with a small floating jellyfish character. The rounded root becomes its pale-pink bell, while three dark-green leaves curl upward into a compact crown and the short roots fan below like a simple skirt. Add a tiny composed face near the lower front, keeping the character botanical rather than human. Let the roots swing slightly to one side as if drifting. Use only pink, dark green, and cream flat shapes with crisp organic contours. Leave the background empty, without water, bubbles, or decorative flowers. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
